scenarios.prompt: Add Prometheus metrics to our checkout API routes in src/routes/checkout.ts to monitor traffic, error rates, and response latency.

actions: Enforce compile-time bounded label set without user_id or request_id in labels
Emit RED metrics: Rate counter, Errors counter, and Duration Histogram
Configure explicit bucket boundaries for P50, P95, and P99 calculation
Attach trace exemplars to histogram recordings

scenarios.prompt: We are adding a Kafka message queue worker for settlement processing. Please implement the producer and consumer logic with full tracing.

actions: Wrap publish in an OpenTelemetry PRODUCER span
Inject W3C traceparent and correlation_id into Kafka message headers
Extract W3C traceparent in worker before execution
Start a child or linked CONSUMER span under the parent trace
Instrument worker USE metrics (concurrency utilization and backlog saturation)

scenarios.prompt: Our on-call team is burned out from receiving pages at 3 AM whenever CPU spikes to 85% for 2 minutes. Redesign our alerting strategy.

actions: Decommission raw CPU and threshold-only resource alerts
Establish Availability and Latency SLIs tied to user experience
Implement Google SRE Multi-Window Multi-Burn-Rate alerts (14.4x 1h/5m for page, 6.0x 6h/30m for ticket)
Verify alerts require both long and short window confirmation

scenarios.prompt: Write a python script to parse a local CSV file of products and generate a summary markdown table for offline documentation.

expected_behavior.reason: Offline local script with no distributed networking, TSDB metrics, async queues, or production SLOs.

scenarios.prompt: Change the background color of the login button from blue to dark slate in tailwind.config.js.

expected_behavior.reason: Static UI CSS style change with no telemetry or observability implications.
